description: Read the numbers: rows of one dataset with filters and aggregates, or indicator values for countries and companies joined across sources (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, SEC).

action.description: Which operation to run. query = rows of one dataset, filtered, sorted, grouped or summarized, needs dataset_id; entity_data = several indicators for one country or company over time, needs entity_id, indicators; compare = one indicator across several countries or companies, needs entities, indicator; profile = every indicator autario holds for one country or company, needs entity_id.

aggregate.description: Comma-separated aggregations as "func(column)". Functions: avg, sum, count, min, max, stddev, median. Example: "avg(value),count(*),max(price)". Result columns are aliased as func_col (e.g. avg_value). Numerically correct on text-stored values.

dataset_id.description: The UUID of the dataset to query

entity_id.description: entity_data: Entity code (e.g. "DEU", "USA", "EUU") profile: Entity code (e.g. "DEU" for Germany, "USA" for United States, "EUU" for European Union, "WLD" for World)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of columns to return (e.g. "country_code,year,value")

filter.description: Filter conditions as "column:operator:value". Operators: eq, neq, gt, lt, gte, lte, like. Example: ["country_code:eq:USA", "year:gte:2000"]

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

full.description: Return the full raw time series (heavy, many tokens). Default false → you get only the summary/stats, which is enough to ANSWER a question. Set true only when you must plot or export every point.

groupby.description: Comma-separated columns for GROUP BY (only valid with aggregate). Example: "country,year". Use with aggregate to compute per-group statistics.

indicator.description: Indicator ID to compare. Get from find_data action "indicators".

indicators.description: Indicator IDs (max 10). Get these from find_data action "indicators" or get_data action "profile".

limit.description: query: Maximum number of rows to return (default 100, max 10000) profile: Max indicators to return (default 100, max 500)

non_null_only.description: Drop rows whose value is null or storage junk (datasets are often mostly empty). Use to avoid wasting tokens on null rows. Default false.

offset.description: query: Number of rows to skip for pagination (default 0) profile: Pagination offset (default 0). When has_more is true, pass offset = previous offset + returned for the next page.

overlay.description: Which data: "source" (default) = exactly what the provider delivered; "with_overlay" = accepted derived columns, corrections and mappings merged in, each row with `_row_key` (use it in propose_*) and `_overlay` (original value, reason, who, when); "proposed" (owner only) = also the open proposals, each with its state. Not combinable with aggregate or summary_only.

sort.description: Sort column and direction (e.g. "year:desc", "value:asc"). Aggregate aliases work too (e.g. "sum_value:desc")

summary_only.description: Return only a finished per-column stats block (n, min, max, avg) plus first/last endpoint values, and NO raw rows. Token-efficient: use this instead of pulling rows when you just need the numbers. Default false.

time.description: entity_data: Optional time range, e.g. "2010-2023" or "2020". Format: YYYY or YYYY-YYYY compare: Optional time range: "2010-2023" or "2020"

name: get_data
